//exclude: supabase/functions holds Deno code, not Next.js code. It imports from
https:// URLs and calls the Deno global, neither of which resolves under

own toolchain, so excluding it here removes a false failure rather than a
out/ is build output that can contain emitted .ts from a previous run.
